articles.summary: The Hackett Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: HCKT), an enterprise AI transformation firm, today announced findings from its 2026 European Working Capital Survey, revealing that despite improving working capital performance, Europe’s largest companies continue to hold an estimated €1.26 trillion in excess working capital equivalent to 14% of annual revenue.
articles.title: The Hackett Group® Study Finds €1.26 Trillion Remains Trapped in Working Capital Across Europe’s Largest Companies

articles.summary: The Hackett Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: HCKT), an ROI led, AI enabled enterprise transformation company that helps organizations achieve and sustain AI World Class performance, today announced its financial results for the third quarter, which ended on September 25, 2026.
articles.title: The Hackett Group Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
